title: Transition Time for Weak Singularities of the Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: This paper constructs a rigorous mathematical framework for investigating laminar-turbulent transition induced by weak singularities of incompressible Navier-Stokes (NS) equations. By integrating the energy identity of Leray weak solutions with the singularity criterion $\left\lVert \boldsymbol{u} \right\rVert_{H_0^1(Ω)}\to0$, a closed analytical form of the laminar-turbulent transition characteristic time is derived. The theoretical scaling $t_{\text{trans}}\simν/U^2$ (equivalent to $t_{\text{trans}}\sim t_c/\text{Re}$) is verified to be consistent with classical experimental observations…
